title: Unit Event — The Legend Still Vivid — Episode5 Never Forgetting What I Saw

meta.Episode: Episode5 — Never Forgetting What I Saw
meta.Event Outline: Thanks to their experience of going camping together, VBS has learned the importance of having a shared vision when they sing. Kohane asks Taiga if there's a way for them to establish a shared vision of RAD WEEKEND without any footage of the event to go off of.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's a place that everybody in Vivid Street talks so highly about, so I was expecting it to be more like a big concert hall...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The distance between the stage and the floor felt no different from any other live house.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I agree.
I was also expecting to see something a little more extravagant.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Your group should've had free reign in terms of choosing a venue, Taiga, so why here...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: We wanted to perform here because we'd been singing here forever.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Granny, what's it like backstage here?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There were a ton of people performing that night, so I'm wondering how you got them to all fit back there.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: You want to see? Come with me.

rows.Speaker: Akito's Voice
rows.Line: Were they all sardine-canned in here...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga's Voice
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was pretty tight.
Hah hah hah.

rows.Speaker: Owner's Voice
rows.Line: A hot mess if you ask me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We may want to wait until Akito and Shiraishi are done taking a look.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still, this is really the stage where Ken and Taiga sang that night...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, this is where it happened...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This is what An and Shinonome have been looking up to all this time.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What did they see? What was it like? I mean, it feels like it had a bigger effect on An than An's singing has had on me...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We shouldn't be putting it on a pedestal. Our goal is to surpass RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Um, Ms. Owner...
Would it be alright if I stood on the stage?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I... I want to see what everything is like from up there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This is where An's dad and Taiga stood, so I want to see things from their perspective...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You want to really know what RAD WEEKEND was like, right? Then, you should be standing up there and not down here.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: How about it, Granny? Mind letting them on stage?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
This feels weird...
We actually get to stand on that stage.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This is where An's dad and Taiga really stood that night...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm pretty sure I was standing somewhere in the middle over there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was more towards the left. Somewhere around there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That was the first time I'd ever been to one of these events too. I wasn't used to having to wait around for so long...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But none of that mattered once everything got started.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Don't you want to give it a try?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<This is where it all began.
This is why our SEKAI exists.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Surpassing RAD WEEKEND wasn't originally my dream. It was something An gave me...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (She wants to know what that night was like.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (She's trying to put herself in my dad and Uncle Taiga's shoes by singing.)

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line:
Hah.
I was planning on kicking them out if they ended up being no good...

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: But for now, let's keep listening.
